features: Clinic preservation versus permanent demolition, eight finite original doses, sourced daily recovery, physical pickup and paid care-supply manufacture.
Gravity water production, actual reservoir limit, exclusive home/clinic diversion and a forecast one-time fitting failure with permanent repair.
Persistent ordinary containers, wounds, deaths and doors on clinic/waterworks; bounded far-entry migration instead of complete resets. Other seven maps retain their prior rules.

Named back-carried rescue takes two visible slots and reduces walking speed20%; recruitment occurs only at successful exit. Authorized rescued medics favor their rescuer at comparable severity; critical injury takes priority.
Shared context card for actual mouse approach and nearby E, local progress and model-driven device changes. Paid completion, interruption and load boundaries are checked.
Nearest-door ordering fixes return paths from the right past multiple closed doors. Unknown-room containers cannot be clicked through fog.
Schema20 migrates authentic published schema19, preserves actual supplies and adds no completed projects. Population-generation date is distinct from observation date.
validation_scope: All72 runtime inputs match the final exported project.2337 logical checks across31 numeric-result suites, plus the font check, pass.

23 existing graphical suites639 checks, cooperation17 and neighborhood20 checks pass. One non-reproduced first-run ObjectDB shutdown warning was investigated with a verbose isolated neighborhood rerun; that exact rerun finishes without the warning and is the reported20-check evidence.
55 prior persistence steps,10 tactical/cooperation and6 neighborhood processes pass, including saved on-site work and carrying a person back through closed doors after restart.

Nine baseline routes and two district routes use normal commands without resource/HP/position/enemy/campaign injection. Both district routes evacuate four living members on day30. Test-policy allocation was corrected to equip distinct living members; game combat values were not reduced to make the cases pass.
Display and desktop preflight use declared item/position/enemy fixtures. Those screenshots are separate from campaign balance evidence.

Exact final Linux ordinary bytes pass cold-server native input/close/restart. Exact final QA bytes pass154 desktop checks: four native sizes, fullscreen, district work/load/payment and diversion preflight, six real minutes, normal OS close and restart.
limitations: Windows uses official Godot4.6.3 export templates; Windows hardware, audible audio and Windows performance are not verified.
The Linux desktop run covers six minutes, while the Windows tool defaults to thirty. It used llvmpipe software rendering under concurrent validation load, not a consumer-GPU performance benchmark.
The new persistent economy applies to two of nine maps. Maps remain two-floor cutaways, and home layouts still need greater variation.
Rescue is back carrying, not an independently controlled escort AI. Gratitude is one explicit behavior consequence, not a complete social simulation.
Campaign evidence uses the normal seed and selected viable policies. Failed allocation attempts are retained locally; this is not a zero-bug or arbitrary-strategy guarantee.
The v1.12 60-day results are historical evidence, not a new v1.13 endless-balance certification.
Original-game research supplies design leads, not copied assets/code or measured original balance thresholds.
